none: PAS NLM-F135B7: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Emperor right issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]VALEN[---]. Reverse description: Emperor standing right holding labarum and dragging captive. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Diameter: 16.5mm, Weight: 2.29gms, die axis: 12
